subject.title: Support 百炼 Token Plan Personal Edition (China mainland, rolling 5h/7d windows)

question: Should CodexBar add the China-mainland Personal Edition as a supported Alibaba Token Plan variant once a redacted subscribed-account response confirms its product code and endpoint contract?
rationale: The feature fits the shared provider model, but the available evidence does not establish the mainland authenticated contract and VISION.md requires sign-off for provider auth/privacy behavior that remains unclear.

options.title: Sponsor verification and implementation
options.body: Approve a shared Personal Edition strategy after a consenting subscriber supplies redacted mainland usage, subscription, and quota-config responses.

options.title: Keep Team Edition only
options.body: Decline the additional variant until Alibaba documents a stable public quota API or the mainland console contract can be safely verified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor verification and implementation
recommendation.body: Approve a shared Personal Edition strategy after a consenting subscriber supplies redacted mainland usage, subscription, and quota-config responses.

likelyOwner.reason: The current vision assigns this auth-sensitive provider expansion to explicit product sign-off, and steipete authored that policy.
